messages.content: 你能幫我找一些遊戲資訊嗎？首先，我想知道在我的Playstation上玩《決勝時刻》可以獲得哪些獎勵。其次，我對Xbox上《國際足盟大賽》第三關的分數和排名很感興趣。第三，我想知道《刺客教條》的所有任務。最後，我想知道在我的PC上玩《要塞英雄》時可以獲得哪些「大師」獎杯等級的獎勵。

function.name: game_scores_get
function.description: Retrieve scores and rankings based on player’s performance in a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

level.description: The level of the game for which you want to retrieve the scores.

player.description: The name of the player for whom you want to retrieve scores.

function.name: game_missions_list
function.description: List all missions for a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: game_rewards_get
function.description: Retrieve information about different types of rewards that you can receive when playing a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

mission.description: The mission for which you want to know the rewards.

trophy.description: The trophy level for which you want to know the rewards.

message.reasoning:
The user wants multiple queries:

1. On PlayStation, playing Call of Duty (《決勝時刻》). They want to know what rewards can be obtained. So we need to call game_rewards_get with game="Call of Duty", platform="Playstation", mission unspecified, trophy unspecified. That will return reward info.

2. On Xbox, playing FIFA (《國際足盟大賽》). They want scores and ranking for level 3. So call game_scores_get with game="FIFA", platform="Xbox", level=3, player unspecified.

3. They want all missions for Assassin's Creed (《刺客教條》). So call game_missions_list with game="Assassin's Creed".

4. On PC, playing Fortnite (《要塞英雄》). They want rewards for trophy "Master" (大師). So call game_rewards_get with game="Fortnite", platform="PC", trophy="Master".

We need to call the functions in order. The user wants all four pieces of information. We can call them sequentially. The best approach: call each function separately. The user didn't specify a particular order, but we can follow the order they listed: first Call of Duty rewards, second FIFA scores, third Assassin's Creed missions, fourth Fortnite Master rewards.

We should call the first function: game_rewards_get with game="Call of Duty", platform="Playstation". Then call game_scores_get with game="FIFA", platform="Xbox", level=3. Then call game_missions_list with game="Assassin's Creed". Then call game_rewards_get with game="Fortnite", platform="PC", trophy="Master".

We need to output the function calls. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we just call the functions.
